profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a video generation platform founded in 2017 and aimed at business users. The company describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business and states that it is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams in 160+ languages. Its core product allows users to produce videos using AI avatars and voiceovers without cameras, microphones, actors, or studios, and the company claims users can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production.

The platform's main features include a custom AI avatar generator, AI voice generation and cloning, a video editor, a PowerPoint-to-video tool, a screen recorder, and interactive avatars. Videos can be produced in 160+ languages, and the service integrates with Learning Management Systems for training and onboarding use cases. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices across all supported languages. The company states that Synthesia is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant and applies both human and AI moderation to content. Content produced on the platform is labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts classify the product under Video Generation and Editing and flag likeness and consent risk as a notable consideration, reflecting the broader industry concern around AI avatars and synthetic media. No litigation, MCP servers, or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
